expectation: INIT publishes the canonical pair at docs/roadmap.
A valid repository-relative custom ROADMAP_PATH is preserved.
Every source need has exactly one explicit covered, deferred, or blocked disposition.
Multi-candidate coverage classifies shared context or ambiguous ownership.
Missing, obsolete, self, and cyclic dependencies block before writes.
Only a lifecycle-valid canonical SPEC workspace is materialized.
Mechanical COMPLETE remains UNKNOWN without durable structured semantic delivery evidence.
Local progress never changes roadmap or Sentinel dependency projection.
RECONCILE preserves IDs, tombstones, title, SPEC path, and requires materialized impact.
A changed model or authority snapshot blocks pair publication.
Every journaled interruption restores one complete old or new owned pair idempotently.
Existing unowned or modified output is preserved and blocks.
Secret-like paths or content block without output mutation.
HTML-like project text is rendered as inert literal content.
Equivalent normalized authority produces byte-identical JSON and HTML.
The page is self-contained, CSP-blocked from networks, responsive, and printable.
Absent candidates expose deterministic MODE=INIT context without creating a SPEC.
__MACOSX, .DS_Store, and AppleDouble entries do not alter canonical discovery.
